segments.title: an animal makes its home

spans.nul: Agent marking has no separate English word; subject relation is expressed by English syntax.

segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment by Codex, independent English-first proposal. This continues the Asvabhava quotation introduced at C05:248. The first gnas is the perceived place to stay; the second is the home in the English residence idiom, with byed pa carrying makes. The glossary records gnas par byed pa as makes his home, but his is supplied and stays unwrapped. de nyid is demonstrative this same, not doctrinal reality; water is supplied from C05:249. blos is retained whole, including its inseparable instrumental ending. la, kyi, par and final dang are omitted because their relations are distributed across the English recast; final dang is not assigned the internal and. The supplied articles, of, as, on the other hand, his and there remain unwrapped. No source wording is corrected.
